facts.text: RoboDesk is a Gymnasium environment: the class subclasses gym.Env
The environment loads the MuJoCo scene model robodesk/assets/desk.xml
The MuJoCo model integrates with a 2 ms timestep (0.002 s)
Each environment step applies the action action_repeat times and runs the physics 10 times per application
The action space is Box(-1, 1, (5,)): five end-effector control values, each between -1 and 1
The robot has nine actuated joints (num_joints = 9)
The observation is a dictionary with image, qpos_robot, qvel_robot, end_effector, qpos_objects and qvel_objects
The image observation space is Box(0, 255, (image_size, image_size, 3), uint8)
The constructor defaults image_size to 64 pixels
The observation spaces are 9 floats for qpos_robot and qvel_robot, 3 floats for end_effector and 26 floats for qpos_objects and qvel_objects
The observation key qpos_objects is populated from physics.data.qvel, not qpos
An episode ends when episode_length is set and num_steps reaches it; there is no other termination condition in step()
The constructor defaults episode_length to 500 time steps
The reward is the task reward clamped to the interval [0, 1]
reset() takes no seed or options argument: it resets the physics, then randomizes the drawer, slide, blocks and ball and the robot start pose with numpy's global random generator
The reward type is one of dense, sparse or success; task defaults to open_slide and reward to dense
step returns (observation, reward, done, info) with info {'discount': 1.0}
Episodes end after 500 time steps by default and there are no early terminations

determinism.notes: upstream reset() draws the object positions and the robot start pose from numpy's global generator and takes no seed argument (robodesk/robodesk.py:207-229); the fake uses its own Python RNG, so no seed reproduces a trajectory and no exact replay is claimed

fidelity.engine: custom:RoboDesk kinematic fake (upstream mujoco robodesk/assets/desk.xml not integrated)
gaps: kinematic fake only: no MuJoCo integration, contacts, friction, gravity, inverse kinematics or Franka Panda actuators are modelled; the upstream rigid-body dynamics are not reproduced
the fake observation image is a 4 x 4 x 3 stand-in; upstream renders 120 x 120 and resizes to image_size x image_size x 3, 64 x 64 x 3 by default (robodesk/robodesk.py:104-105, 114-131)

the six observation keys are present but carry placeholder values; the upstream qpos_objects-from-qvel defect is mirrored (robodesk/robodesk.py:385), and no task reward function is modelled (the fake returns a constant placeholder reward)
one fake step is one control step and does not model action_repeat, task, reward-type or image_size constructor options
no rendering, no camera, no get_state/set_state: snapshot and exact replay are not offered
no wall-clock pacing: simulated time advances only when a step command arrives (realtime_factor 0)
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment, which is not importable where the gate runs; trajectories and arrays are not validated against MuJoCo

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop no step or reset is accepted until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the simulated state is kept and stays readable
